description: Every product that uses a material, with the parts, the form, finish, standard and part number, the quote and the source for each: "which products use aluminium 6061 and for which part", "what flew with Kapton and with what finish or standard". The material is an id (find it with search_materials, or from get_product.materials). part_function narrows to parts with one function. Works for materials with a page (material_state profile) and for reserved ids (state reserved: the id is known from products but has no page yet). Products also listed the material in their flat materials list appear under listed. Orbit and size tags tell you what kind of mission it flew on. An empty answer means no catalogued product names that material.

material.description: Material id, for example aluminium-6061 or pi-kapton-hn
